result.stdout:
USAGE:
    DiagramGenerator.CLI.dll <input paths> [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    <input paths>    One or more .sql files, directories, or glob patterns (e.g.
                     ./procs/*.sql) to generate diagrams for                    

OPTIONS:
                       DEFAULT                                                  
    -h, --help                    Prints help information                       
    -o, --output                  Directory to write generated diagrams to.     
                                  Defaults to the current directory             
    -r, --recursive    True       Search subdirectories when an input path is a 
                                  directory                                     
    -f, --format       Mermaid    Output format: mermaid (default, raw .mmd     
                                  text) or json (includes the full graph)       
    -q, --quiet                   Suppress informational output                 
    -k, --key                     Your API key. Falls back to the               
                                  BNL_DIAGRAMS_API_KEY environment variable
